data.title: Speech-to-text (STT) – for Jørgen
data.description: Jørgen: please focus on STT. Done = a Python function that records from the laptop mic (push-to-talk, triggered by an event from the Atech board or a keypress) and returns a transcript that handles Norwegian well, in under ~3 s. Keep a typed-text fallback for a noisy demo room. Publish the function signature as a contract so the Claude loop can call it.
